title: Run the react harness family through CLI tool_loop init
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `react` and backend `mock`. Fangore switches the host to the classic ReAct family so models without reliable native tool calls still loop Thought/Action/Observation. He starts from the same CLI tool-loop verb, with family=react bound at harness initialization, and expects a final answer after one scripted tool round. He walks product steps (tool_loop) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario.
implementation: `UserStoryScenario.environment.family` / `tool_loop.family=react` select `ReactHarness` via `_CliToolLoopConfig.get_harness_class` (Config DI). Story harness scripts Action/Final Answer turns on `ScriptedInference`. Emits the same EventLog inference/tool stream as other families.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `react_tool_round.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
